subject: general
question: Pottery was first traceable to which period of ancient Indian history?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Neolithic**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pottery** was first traceable to the **Neolithic period of ancient Indian history**.
 
• Pottery encompasses both the process and the resulting objects formed from clay and other ceramic materials.
 
• It involves shaping a ceramic body into desired forms and then subjecting them to high temperatures in a bonfire, pit, or kiln.
 
• This ancient craft is among the oldest human inventions, dating back thousands of years.
 
• The oldest known pottery, originating from the **Neolithic revolution** approximately 10,000 years ago, serves as evidence of its early development.
 
• The Greeks are acknowledged for elevating pottery to an art form, showcasing intricate designs and techniques that continue to inspire today.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• **The Neolithic or New Stone Age, **derived from the Greek words for "new" and "stone," denotes an archaeological epoch and the final segment of the Stone Age across Europe, Asia, and Africa.
 
• It witnessed the Neolithic Revolution, a series of developments such as farming, animal domestication, and the transition from a hunter-gatherer lifestyle to settled communities.
 
• Coined by Sir John Lubbock in 1865, the term "Neolithic" refined the three-age system.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Chalcolithic period**, also known as the Copper Age, served as a transitional phase from the Neolithic to the Bronze Age.
 
• **The Palaeolithic, or Paleolithic,** denotes a prehistoric era beginning approximately 3.3 million years ago and concluding around 11,650 years ago.
 
• **The Mesolithic, or Middle Stone Age**, refers to an archaeological epoch lasting from approximately 10,000 to 5,000 BC.
